title: Task params for oedis.handler.storage.download
description: Configuration for copying files from a storage base URI into the task inbox.

connection.description: Storage connection settings used to resolve the remote base path.

uri.description: Remote storage base path or URI, for example /Volumes/my_catalog/my_schema/my_volume or abfss://container@account.dfs.core.windows.net/dropzone.

requests.description: List of download instructions. Each item describes one remote source selection under connection.uri and how matched files should be copied into the inbox.

src_dir.description: Remote source directory relative to connection.uri. Leave empty or omit it to discover files directly from the base URI. Absolute paths and full URIs are rejected.

dst_dir.description: Destination directory under ctx.inbox. Leave empty or omit it to copy directly into ctx.inbox. Must be a relative local path when provided.

include.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to include. When recursive is false, matching is against file names only. When recursive is true, matching is attempted against both file names and paths relative to src_dir. Prefer recursive=true with patterns like '*.csv' instead of '**/*.csv'.

exclude.description: File match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. When recursive is false, matching is against file names only. When recursive is true, matching is attempted against both file names and paths relative to src_dir.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under the resolved remote source root. When false, only files directly under that root are considered.
